Chinese_translation: 原子影視傳播有限公司
Creator: Edward Yang
Location: No. 37-92, Sec. 4, Renai Rd., Daan Dist., Taipei City, Taiwan
Subject: Independent Cinema,Taiwan New Cinema,Institutional Reform
Relation: Astro Boy: THE BRAVE IN SPACE
Description: An independent production entity founded by Edward Yang in 1992. This entity served as the operational core during his "Independent Exploration" period, overseeing the production of A Confucian Confusion (1994) and Mahjong (1996). Its nomenclature derives from Yang’s inheritance of the humanistic spirit of Osamu Tezuka’s Astro Boy (Mighty Atom), symbolizing a pivotal professional shift away from the rigid studio system in pursuit of cinematic and artistic autonomy.
